bffx 0.1.3-beta
usage:
  bffx new NAME
  bffx sync [--dry-run]
  bffx dev
  bffx build
  bffx test
  bffx routes list
  bffx generate resource NAME field:type ...
  bffx generate scaffold NAME field:type ...
  bffx generate builder NAME
  bffx generate action NAME
  bffx generate skill NAME
  bffx generate function NAME
  bffx generate service NAME
  bffx generate stream NAME
  bffx generate pipeline TYPE --name NAME --feature FEATURE [--catalog=ADAPTER]
  bffx generate client [platform]
  bffx add admin
  bffx env check
  bffx mcp serve [--transport stdio|http]
  bffx doctor
  bffx migrate [init|plan|apply|status|diff|layout|packaging]
  bffx db backup [--path FILE]   (SQLite-only, online VACUUM INTO snapshot)
  bffx upgrade
  bffx deploy [init|ship|rollback|status|cloud]
  bffx update framework [--vendor-only] [--root DIR] [--dry-run] [--force]
  bffx lint [--root DIR] [--strict]
  bffx seed [--root DIR] [--upsert]
  bffx check [--root DIR] [--strict]
